name: Nautical Charts
description: Sailor-oriented overlay: OpenSeaMap seamarks (buoys, beacons, lights), depth contours, optional NOAA charts in US waters, and harbours/marinas with facility details. Click a harbour to open its place panel.

openseamap.purpose: Render OpenSeaMap seamark tiles as a transparent overlay.
openseamap.dataReceived: PNG raster tiles showing buoys, beacons, lights, fairways, anchorages, and other IHO S-57 features.

openstreetmap.purpose: Render OpenSeaMap depth-contour and GEBCO bathymetry as raster tiles via WMS proxy.
openstreetmap.dataReceived: PNG raster tiles showing isobaths and shaded relief of the seafloor.

gebco.purpose: Render NOAA Maritime Chart Service tiles in US waters via WMS proxy.
gebco.dataReceived: PNG raster tiles of the official NOAA paper-chart equivalents.

noaa-ncds.purpose: List OpenSeaMap harbours and marinas in the viewport, enrich the clicked harbour with seamark facilities via Overpass.
noaa-ncds.dataSent: Viewport bounding box, optionally harbour ID + coordinates for enrichment.
noaa-ncds.dataReceived: Harbour list (id, name, coordinates, category) and nearby seamark facilities (berths, fuel, moorings, …).

noaa-co-ops.purpose: Provide tide predictions and observed water levels at US coastal tide-gauge stations.
noaa-co-ops.dataSent: A station ID and a date/time range (and a station-type filter when fetching the station catalog). No personal data.
noaa-co-ops.dataReceived: Station catalog (id, name, coordinates) and per-station predicted high/low tides and observed water-level readings.

kartverket-sjokart.purpose: Render official Norwegian nautical chart tiles for Norway and Svalbard via WMS proxy.
kartverket-sjokart.dataReceived: PNG raster tiles of the Kartverket Sjøkart sea charts.

dfo-iwls.purpose: Provide tide predictions and observed water levels at Canadian tide-gauge stations.
dfo-iwls.dataSent: A station ID and a from/to time range (and a time-series-code filter when fetching the station catalog). No personal data.
dfo-iwls.dataReceived: Station catalog (id, name, coordinates) and per-station predicted high/low tides and observed water-level readings.

kartverket-sehavniva.purpose: Provide tide predictions and observed water levels at Norwegian tide-gauge stations.
kartverket-sehavniva.dataSent: A station's latitude/longitude and a from/to time range for the requested data. No personal data.
kartverket-sehavniva.dataReceived: Station catalog (name, code, coordinates) and per-station predicted and observed water levels.

wsv-pegelonline.purpose: Provide observed water levels at German coastal and estuarine tide gauges (North Sea and Baltic Sea).
wsv-pegelonline.dataSent: A station UUID for the measurement series (and a North Sea / Baltic Sea waters filter when fetching the station catalog). No personal data.
wsv-pegelonline.dataReceived: Station catalog (uuid, name, coordinates) and per-station water-level measurements.

ioc-sealevel.purpose: Provide observed sea-level data from the global IOC tide-gauge monitoring network.
ioc-sealevel.dataSent: A station code and a time period in days for observations. No personal data.
ioc-sealevel.dataReceived: Station catalog (code, location, coordinates) and per-station sea-level observations.

emodnet-physics.purpose: Surface near-real-time sea-level monitoring stations across Europe as map markers.
emodnet-physics.dataSent: A request for the near-real-time sea-level station layer; no location or query parameters derived from the user are sent.
emodnet-physics.dataReceived: Sea-level station locations (platform code, coordinates) with last-observation timestamps.
